title: My 3D animation to 2D animated Sprite sheet workflow
author: ajdare
selftext:
In around 5 minutes I can create concept art -> 3D model -> rig -> animated and convert to a 2D animated sprite using a combination of AI and Sorceress workflows  
All tools from [https://sorceress.games](https://sorceress.games)

replies.author: PuteMorte
replies.body: It's using ground tiles from diablo 2 lol

comments.author: AnarchyDex
comments.body: This isamazing how long did it take you to make the souceress engine thing?

comments.author: Bratchan
comments.body: Is there something i can upload a 3d model and then have it rig and do aniamtions then i can download fbx?

replies.author: ProThoughtDesign
replies.body: If Mixamo is still online you can. They stopped developing it, but it still works.

replies.author: Bratchan
replies.body: Sadly it doesn't have the types of animations i need. I love the website hate tha they stopped developing it.

replies.author: ProThoughtDesign
replies.body: It still works for rigging and downloading a rigged T-Pose .fbx file. I do this type of workflow in Blender already.

replies.author: Bratchan
replies.body: I am hoping for text to animations. I hate animation lol so trying to avoid it if i can. I don't mind tweeking something in blender i have done that. BUt trying to not have to build the full animations.

replies.author: Endlesscrysis
replies.body: The same applies, you can use mixamo for rigging and then use text to 3d animation. I think nvidia has one and tencent if my memory is correct. Hymotion is the tencent one.

comments.body: Hahaha, I’ve used your platform already and after hitting walls on animation consistency I came to the same conclusion of 3d -> sprite is the most consistent way. My pet project to solve it has been on the back burner does this approach also give normal maps to the sprites?

comments.author: Subotaplaya
comments.body: That's cool, dog. No doubt you'll make 10,000 games per year and disrupt the bloated and oppressive games industry and save all the children, with that kind of powerful modern tools and efficiency. Keep up the hard work.
